name: Marco Scarpi
bio: Born on March 19, 1998 in Venice Marco Scarpi grew up in Cavallino-Treporti, a peninsular turistic town located between the sea and the lagoon. Scarpi’s visual language is characterized by a broad research in material experimentation, often influenced by his own personal experiences, creating enigmatic narratives challenging emotions and feelings both universal and specific. He currently lives and works in Florence.
